claims.head: The Golden Knights played last night
claims.body: The Golden Knights played last night and get no rest before this one. Teams in that spot usually get the worse of the chances, so we expect the Predators to control more of the play than they usually do.
claims.call: The Predators get a bigger share of the 5-on-5 chances than they usually do.

NSH.head: A tough matchup for Nashville
NSH.body: Even though Vegas is on the second night of a back-to-back, while Nashville has home-ice advantage, Vegas has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately. Nashville’s best way through is keeping dangerous shots away.

VGK.head: The matchup suits Vegas
VGK.body: Even though Vegas is on the second night of a back-to-back, while Nashville has home-ice advantage, Vegas has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately. Nashville’s way back in is keeping dangerous shots away.

story.head: Theodore’s favorite opponent
paras: The Golden Knights come in at 5-2-0, the Predators at 2-1-2.
The Golden Knights shoot a lot, and the Predators give up plenty. The Knights’ defensemen shoot a lot, and the Predators’ not so much.
